editorial.description_en: Water deep enough that what comes back is only what the water did not absorb.
editorial.description_ja: 深い水のような、濃く重い青。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.440, C 0.104, h 240.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 深 (fuka, deep) + 水 (mizu, water). It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Deep Water" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 深水. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — yu-dachi at ΔE00 7.5, yoi-zora at ΔE00 8.5, en-yo at ΔE00 8.9. complementary is the entry nearest the opposite OKLCh hue (60°), within 22°. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
